title: NSA may have tracked Sherman since childhood
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NSA may have tracked Sherman since childhood, about 1960s-1990s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Sherman believes the NSA may even have tracked him since childhood [music] into his young adulthood and military service

plain: Dan Sherman is a former military sergeant who says the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, hired him to communicate with aliens. According to podcast host Jesse Michels, Sherman believes the NSA may have been tracking him since childhood, through his young adulthood and into his military service. If that were true, it would mean he was picked out for the role long before he knew about it.
